        "contents": "func (ui *UI) AnalyzePath(path string, parentDir fs.Item) error {\n\tui.progress = tview.NewTextView().SetText(\"Scanning...\")\n\tui.progress.SetBorder(true).SetBorderPadding(2, 2, 2, 2)\n\tui.progress.SetTitle(\" Scanning... \")\n\tui.progress.SetDynamicColors(true)\n\n\tflex := tview.NewFlex().\n\t\tAddItem(nil, 0, 1, false).\n\t\tAddItem(tview.NewFlex().SetDirection(tview.FlexRow).\n\t\t\tAddItem(nil, 0, 1, false).\n\t\t\tAddItem(ui.progress, 8, 1, false).\n\t\t\tAddItem(nil, 0, 1, false), 0, 50, false).\n\t\tAddItem(nil, 0, 1, false)\n\n\tui.pages.AddPage(\"progress\", flex, true, true)\n\n\tgo ui.updateProgress()\n\n\tgo func() {\n\t\tdefer debug.FreeOSMemory()\n\t\tcurrentDir := ui.Analyzer.AnalyzeDir(path, ui.CreateIgnoreFunc(), ui.CreateFileTypeFilter(), ui.ConstGC)\n\n\t\tif parentDir != nil {\n\t\t\tcurrentDir.SetParent(parentDir)\n\t\t\tparentDir.SetFiles(parentDir.GetFiles().RemoveByName(currentDir.GetName()))\n\t\t\tparentDir.AddFile(currentDir)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tui.topDirPath = path\n\t\t\tui.topDir = currentDir\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tui.topDir.UpdateStats(ui.linkedItems)\n\n\t\tui.app.QueueUpdateDraw(func() {\n\t\t\tui.currentDir = currentDir\n\t\t\tui.showDir()\n\t\t\tui.pages.RemovePage(\"progress\")\n\t\t})\n\n\t\tif ui.done != nil {\n\t\t\tui.done &lt;- struct{}{}\n\t\t}\n\t}()\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ReadAnalysis reads analysis report from JSON file\nfunc (ui *UI) ReadAnalysis(input io.Reader) error {\n\tui.progress = tview.NewTextView().SetText(\"Reading analysis from file...\")",

        "contents": "// SetArchiveBrowsing sets whether browsing of zip/jar archives is enabled\nfunc (a *StoredAnalyzer) SetArchiveBrowsing(v bool) {\n\ta.archiveBrowsing = v\n}\n\n// SetFileTypeFilter sets the file type filter function\nfunc (a *StoredAnalyzer) SetFileTypeFilter(filter common.ShouldFileBeIgnored) {\n\ta.ignoreFileType = filter\n}\n\n// ResetProgress returns progress\nfunc (a *StoredAnalyzer) ResetProgress() {\n\ta.progress = &amp;common.CurrentProgress{}\n\ta.progressChan = make(chan common.CurrentProgress, 1)\n\ta.progressOutChan = make(chan common.CurrentProgress, 1)\n\ta.progressDoneChan = make(chan struct{})\n\ta.doneChan = make(common.SignalGroup)\n\ta.wait = (&amp;WaitGroup{}).Init()\n}\n\n// AnalyzeDir analyzes given path\nfunc (a *StoredAnalyzer) AnalyzeDir(\n\tpath string, ignore common.ShouldDirBeIgnored, fileTypeFilter common.ShouldFileBeIgnored, constGC bool,\n) fs.Item {\n\tif !constGC {\n\t\tdefer debug.SetGCPercent(debug.SetGCPercent(-1))\n\t\tgo manageMemoryUsage(a.doneChan)\n\t}\n\n\ta.ignoreDir = ignore\n\ta.ignoreFileType = fileTypeFilter\n\n\ta.storage = NewStorage(a.storagePath, path)\n\tcloseFn := a.storage.Open()\n\tdefer func() {\n\t\t// nasty hack to close storage after all goroutines are done\n\t\t// Wait returns immediately if value is 0\n\t\t// few last goroutines might still start after that\n\t\ttime.Sleep(1 * time.Second)\n\t\tcloseFn()\n\t}()\n\n\ta.ignoreDir = ignore\n\n\tgo a.updateProgress()\n\tdir := a.processDir(path)\n\n\ta.wait.Wait()\n\n\ta.progressDoneChan &lt;- struct{}{}\n\ta.doneChan.Broadcast()\n\n\treturn dir\n}\n\nfunc (a *StoredAnalyzer) processDir(path string) *StoredDir",

0:\n\t\tui.printTopFiles(dir)\n\tcase ui.depth &gt; 0:\n\t\tui.printDirWithDepth(dir, 0)\n\tcase ui.summarize:\n\t\tui.printTotalItem(dir)\n\tdefault:\n\t\tui.showDir(dir)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ReadFromStorage reads analysis data from persistent key-value storage\nfunc (ui *UI) ReadFromStorage(storagePath, path string) error {\n\tstorage := analyze.NewStorage(storagePath, path)\n\tcloseFn := storage.Open()\n\tdefer closeFn()\n\n\tdir, err := storage.GetDirForPath(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tswitch {\n\tcase ui.top &gt; 0:\n\t\tui.printTopFiles(dir)\n\tcase ui.summarize:\n\t\tui.printTotalItem(dir)\n\tdefault:\n\t\tui.showDir(dir)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (ui *UI) showDir(dir fs.Item) {\n\tif ui.reverseSort {\n\t\tsort.Sort(dir.GetFiles())\n\t} else {\n\t\tsort.Sort(sort.Reverse(dir.GetFiles()))\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, file := range dir.GetFiles() {\n\t\tui.printItem(file)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (ui *UI) printTopFiles(file fs.Item) {\n\tcollected := analyze.CollectTopFiles(file, ui.top)\n\tfor _, file := range collected {\n\t\tui.printItemPath(file)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (ui *UI) printTotalItem(file fs.Item) {\n\tvar lineFormat string\n\tif ui.UseColors {\n\t\tlineFormat = \"%20s %s\\n\"\n\t} else {\n\t\tlineFormat = \"%9s %s\\n\"\n\t}\n\n\tvar size int64\n\tif ui.ShowApparentSize {\n\t\tsize = file.GetSize()\n\t} else {\n\t\tsize = file.GetUsage()\n\t}\n\n\tfmt.Fprintf(\n\t\tui.output,\n\t\tlineFormat,\n\t\tui.formatSize(size),\n\t\tfile.GetName(),\n\t)\n}\n\nfunc (ui *UI) printItem(file fs.Item) {\n\tvar lineFormat string",

        "contents": "func (a *App) runAction(ui UI, path string) error {\n\tif a.Flags.Profiling {\n\t\tgo func() {\n\t\t\thttp.HandleFunc(\"/debug/pprof/\", pprof.Index)\n\t\t\thttp.HandleFunc(\"/debug/pprof/cmdline\", pprof.Cmdline)\n\t\t\thttp.HandleFunc(\"/debug/pprof/profile\", pprof.Profile)\n\t\t\thttp.HandleFunc(\"/debug/pprof/symbol\", pprof.Symbol)\n\t\t\thttp.HandleFunc(\"/debug/pprof/trace\", pprof.Trace)\n\t\t\tlog.Println(http.ListenAndServe(\"localhost:6060\", nil))\n\t\t}()\n\t}\n\n\tswitch {\n\tcase a.Flags.ShowDisks:\n\t\tif err := ui.ListDevices(a.Getter); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"loading mount points: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\tcase a.Flags.InputFile != \"\":\n\t\tvar input io.Reader\n\t\tvar err error\n\t\tif a.Flags.InputFile == \"-\" {\n\t\t\tinput = os.Stdin\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tinput, err = os.OpenFile(a.Flags.InputFile, os.O_RDONLY, 0o600)\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"opening input file: %w\", err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err := ui.ReadAnalysis(input); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"reading analysis: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\tcase a.Flags.ReadFromStorage:\n\t\tui.SetAnalyzer(analyze.CreateStoredAnalyzer(a.Flags.StoragePath))\n\t\tif err := ui.ReadFromStorage(a.Flags.StoragePath, path); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"reading from storage (%s): %w\", a.Flags.StoragePath, err)\n\t\t}\n\tdefault:\n\t\tif build.RootPathPrefix != \"\" {\n\t\t\tpath = build.RootPathPrefix + path\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t_, err := a.PathChecker(path)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"Analyzing path: %s\", path)\n\t\tif err := ui.AnalyzePath(path, nil); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scanning dir: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}",

        "contents": "\")\n\t}\n\n\treturn processDir(items)\n}\n\nfunc processDir(items []interface{}) (dir *analyze.Dir, err error) {\n\tdir = &amp;analyze.Dir{\n\t\tFile: &amp;analyze.File{\n\t\t\tFlag: ' ',\n\t\t},\n\t}\n\tdirMap, ok := items[0].(map[string]interface{})\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"directory item is not a map\")\n\t}\n\tname, ok := dirMap[\"name\"].(string)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"directory name is not a string\")\n\t}\n\tif mtime, ok := dirMap[\"mtime\"].(float64); ok {\n\t\tdir.Mtime = time.Unix(int64(mtime), 0)\n\t}\n\n\tslashPos := strings.LastIndex(name, \"/\")\n\tif slashPos &gt; -1 {\n\t\tdir.Name = name[slashPos+1:]\n\t\tdir.BasePath = name[:slashPos+1]\n\t} else {\n\t\tdir.Name = name\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, v := range items[1:] {\n\t\tswitch item := v.(type) {\n\t\tcase map[string]interface{}:\n\t\t\tfile := &amp;analyze.File{}\n\t\t\tfile.Name = item[\"name\"].(string)\n\n\t\t\tif asize, ok := item[\"asize\"].(float64); ok {\n\t\t\t\tfile.Size = int64(asize)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif dsize, ok := item[\"dsize\"].(float64); ok {\n\t\t\t\tfile.Usage = int64(dsize)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif mtime, ok := item[\"mtime\"].(float64); ok {\n\t\t\t\tfile.Mtime = time.Unix(int64(mtime), 0)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif _, ok := item[\"notreg\"].(bool); ok {\n\t\t\t\tfile.Flag = '@'\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tfile.Flag = ' '\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif mli, ok := item[\"ino\"].(float64); ok {\n\t\t\t\tfile.Mli = uint64(mli)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif _, ok := item[\"hlnkc\"].(bool); ok {\n\t\t\t\tfile.Flag = 'H'\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tfile.Parent = dir\n\n\t\t\tdir.AddFile(file)\n\t\tcase []interface{}:\n\t\t\tsubdir, err := processDir(item)\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tsubdir.Parent = dir\n\t\t\tdir.AddFile(subdir)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn dir, nil\n}",

        "contents": "func (a *SequentialAnalyzer) SetFileTypeFilter(filter common.ShouldFileBeIgnored) {\n\ta.ignoreFileType = filter\n}\n\n// GetProgressChan returns channel for getting progress\nfunc (a *SequentialAnalyzer) GetProgressChan() chan common.CurrentProgress {\n\treturn a.progressOutChan\n}\n\n// GetDone returns channel for checking when analysis is done\nfunc (a *SequentialAnalyzer) GetDone() common.SignalGroup {\n\treturn a.doneChan\n}\n\n// ResetProgress returns progress\nfunc (a *SequentialAnalyzer) ResetProgress() {\n\ta.progress = &amp;common.CurrentProgress{}\n\ta.progressChan = make(chan common.CurrentProgress, 1)\n\ta.progressOutChan = make(chan common.CurrentProgress, 1)\n\ta.progressDoneChan = make(chan struct{})\n\ta.doneChan = make(common.SignalGroup)\n}\n\n// AnalyzeDir analyzes given path\nfunc (a *SequentialAnalyzer) AnalyzeDir(\n\tpath string, ignore common.ShouldDirBeIgnored, fileTypeFilter common.ShouldFileBeIgnored, constGC bool,\n) fs.Item {\n\tif !constGC {\n\t\tdefer debug.SetGCPercent(debug.SetGCPercent(-1))\n\t\tgo manageMemoryUsage(a.doneChan)\n\t}\n\n\ta.ignoreDir = ignore\n\ta.ignoreFileType = fileTypeFilter\n\n\tgo a.updateProgress()\n\tdir := a.processDir(path)\n\n\tdir.BasePath = filepath.Dir(path)\n\n\ta.progressDoneChan &lt;- struct{}{}\n\ta.doneChan.Broadcast()\n\n\treturn dir\n}\n\nfunc (a *SequentialAnalyzer) processDir(path string) *Dir",

RLock() func() {\n\tpanic(\"SetFiles should not be called on file\")\n}\n\n// SetFiles panics on file\nfunc (f *File) SetFiles(files fs.Files) {\n\tpanic(\"SetFiles should not be called on file\")\n}\n\n// AddFile panics on file\nfunc (f *File) AddFile(item fs.Item) {\n\tpanic(\"AddFile should not be called on file\")\n}\n\n// RemoveFile panics on file\nfunc (f *File) RemoveFile(item fs.Files {\n\treturn f.Files\n}\n\n// GetFilesLocked returns all files in directory\n// It is safe to call this function from multiple goroutines\nfunc (f *Dir) GetFilesLocked() fs.Files {\n\tf.m.RLock()\n\tdefer f.m.RUnlock()\n\treturn f.GetFiles()[:]\n}\n\n// SetFiles sets files in directory\nfunc (f *Dir) SetFiles(files fs.Files) {\n\tf.Files = files\n}\n\n// GetType returns name type of item\nfunc (f *Dir) GetType() string {\n\treturn \"Directory\"\n}\n\n// GetItemCount returns number of files in dir\nfunc (f *Dir) GetItemCount() int {\n\tf.m.RLock()\n\tdefer f.m.RUnlock()\n\treturn f.ItemCount\n}\n\n// IsDir returns true for dir\nfunc (f *Dir) IsDir() bool {\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// GetPath returns absolute path of the file\nfunc (f *Dir) GetPath() string {\n\tif f.BasePath != \"\" {\n\t\treturn filepath.Join(f.BasePath, f.Name)\n\t}\n\tif f.Parent != nil {\n\t\treturn filepath.Join(f.Parent.GetPath(), f.Name)\n\t}\n\treturn f.Name\n}\n\n//         "contents": "package analyze\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"github.com/dundee/gdu/v5/pkg/fs\"\n)\n\n// TopList is a list of top largest files\ntype TopList struct {\n\tItems   fs.Files\n\tCount   int\n\tMinSize int64\n}\n\n// NewTopList creates new TopList\nfunc NewTopList(count int) *TopList {\n\treturn &amp;TopList{Count: count}\n}\n\n// Add adds file to the list\nfunc (tl *TopList) Add(file fs.Item) {\n\tif file.GetSize() &gt; tl.MinSize || len(tl.Items) &lt; tl.Count {\n\t\ttl.Items = append(tl.Items, file)\n\t\tsort.Sort(fs.ByApparentSize(tl.Items))\n\t\tif len(tl.Items) &gt; tl.Count {\n\t\t\ttl.Items = tl.Items[1:]\n\t\t}\n\t\ttl.MinSize = tl.Items[0].GetSize()\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc CollectTopFiles(dir fs.Item, count int) fs.Files {\n\ttopList := NewTopList(count)\n\twalkDir(dir, topList)\n\tsort.Sort(sort.Reverse(fs.ByApparentSize(topList.Items)))\n\treturn topList.Items\n}\n\nfunc walkDir(dir fs.Item, topList *TopList) {\n\tfor _, item := range dir.GetFiles() {\n\t\tif item.IsDir() {\n\t\t\twalkDir(item, topList)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\ttopList.Add(item)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "func processZipFile(zipPath string, info os.FileInfo) (zipDir *ZipDir, err error) {\n\treader, err := zip.OpenReader(zipPath)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdefer reader.Close()\n\n\t// Create root directory\n\tzipDir = &amp;ZipDir{\n\t\tDir: &amp;Dir{\n\t\t\tFile: &amp;File{\n\t\t\t\tName:  filepath.Base(zipPath),\n\t\t\t\tFlag:  'Z', // Use 'Z' to identify zip files\n\t\t\t\tSize:  info.Size(),\n\t\t\t\tUsage: info.Size(),\n\t\t\t\tMtime: info.ModTime(),\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tItemCount: 1,\n\t\t\tFiles:     make(fs.Files, 0),\n\t\t},\n\t\tzipPath: zipPath,\n\t}\n\n\t// Use map to store directory structure\n\tdirMap := make(map[string]*ZipDir)\n\tdirMap[\"\"] = zipDir // root directory\n\n\tfor _, f := range reader.File {\n\t\tif f.FileInfo().IsDir() {\n\t\t\tcontinue // Skip directory entries, we'll create them automatically based on file paths\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Parse file path and ensure all parent directories exist\n\t\tdirPath := filepath.Dir(f.Name)\n\t\tif dirPath == \".\" {\n\t\t\tdirPath = \"\" // root directory\n\t\t}\n\t\tensureZipDirExists(dirMap, dirPath, zipPath, zipDir)\n\n\t\t// Create file item\n\t\tparentDir := dirMap[dirPath]\n\t\tzipFile := &amp;ZipFile{\n\t\t\tFile: &amp;File{\n\t\t\t\tName:   filepath.Base(f.Name),\n\t\t\t\tFlag:   ' ',\n\t\t\t\tSize:   int64(f.UncompressedSize64),\n\t\t\t\tUsage:  int64(f.CompressedSize64),\n\t\t\t\tMtime:  f.FileInfo().ModTime(),\n\t\t\t\tParent: parentDir,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tzipPath:   zipPath,\n\t\t\tinZipPath: f.Name,\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tparentDir.AddFile(zipFile)\n\t}\n\n\treturn zipDir, nil\n}\n\n// ensureZipDirExists ensures all directories in the specified path exist\nfunc ensureZipDirExists(dirMap map[string]*ZipDir, path, zipPath string, rootDir *ZipDir) {\n\tif path == \"\" || path == \".\" {\n\t\treturn\n\t}",

        "contents": "func (a *ParallelAnalyzer) SetFileTypeFilter(filter common.ShouldFileBeIgnored) {\n\ta.ignoreFileType = filter\n}\n\n// GetProgressChan returns channel for getting progress\nfunc (a *ParallelAnalyzer) GetProgressChan() chan common.CurrentProgress {\n\treturn a.progressOutChan\n}\n\n// GetDone returns channel for checking when analysis is done\nfunc (a *ParallelAnalyzer) GetDone() common.SignalGroup {\n\treturn a.doneChan\n}\n\n// ResetProgress returns progress\nfunc (a *ParallelAnalyzer) ResetProgress() {\n\ta.progress = &amp;common.CurrentProgress{}\n\ta.progressChan = make(chan common.CurrentProgress, 1)\n\ta.progressOutChan = make(chan common.CurrentProgress, 1)\n\ta.progressDoneChan = make(chan struct{})\n\ta.doneChan = make(common.SignalGroup)\n\ta.wait = (&amp;WaitGroup{}).Init()\n}\n\n// AnalyzeDir analyzes given path\nfunc (a *ParallelAnalyzer) AnalyzeDir(\n\tpath string, ignore common.ShouldDirBeIgnored, fileTypeFilter common.ShouldFileBeIgnored, constGC bool,\n) fs.Item {\n\tif !constGC {\n\t\tdefer debug.SetGCPercent(debug.SetGCPercent(-1))\n\t\tgo manageMemoryUsage(a.doneChan)\n\t}\n\n\ta.ignoreDir = ignore\n\ta.ignoreFileType = fileTypeFilter\n\n\tgo a.updateProgress()\n\tdir := a.processDir(path)\n\n\tdir.BasePath = filepath.Dir(path)\n\ta.wait.Wait()\n\n\ta.progressDoneChan &lt;- struct{}{}\n\ta.doneChan.Broadcast()\n\n\treturn dir\n}\n\nfunc (a *ParallelAnalyzer) processDir(path string) *Dir",

        "contents": "func (ui *UI) printItem(file fs.Item) {\n\tvar lineFormat string\n\tif ui.UseColors {\n\t\tlineFormat = \"%s %20s %s\\n\"\n\t} else {\n\t\tlineFormat = \"%s %9s %s\\n\"\n\t}\n\n\tvar size int64\n\tif ui.ShowApparentSize {\n\t\tsize = file.GetSize()\n\t} else {\n\t\tsize = file.GetUsage()\n\t}\n\n\tif file.IsDir() {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(ui.output,\n\t\t\tlineFormat,\n\t\t\tstring(file.GetFlag()),\n\t\t\tui.formatSize(size),\n\t\t\tui.blue.Sprint(\"/\"+file.GetName()))\n\t} else {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(ui.output,\n\t\t\tlineFormat,\n\t\t\tstring(file.GetFlag()),\n\t\t\tui.formatSize(size),\n\t\t\tfile.GetName())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (ui *UI) printItemPath(file fs.Item) {\n\tvar lineFormat string\n\tif ui.UseColors {\n\t\tlineFormat = \"%20s %s\\n\"\n\t} else {\n\t\tlineFormat = \"%9s %s\\n\"\n\t}\n\n\tvar size int64\n\tif ui.ShowApparentSize {\n\t\tsize = file.GetSize()\n\t} else {\n\t\tsize = file.GetUsage()\n\t}\n\n\tif file.IsDir() {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(ui.output,\n\t\t\tlineFormat,\n\t\t\tui.formatSize(size),\n\t\t\tui.blue.Sprint(file.GetPath()))\n\t} else {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(ui.output,\n\t\t\tlineFormat,\n\t\t\tui.formatSize(size),\n\t\t\tfile.GetPath())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (ui *UI) printDirWithDepth(dir fs.Item, currentDepth int) {\n\t// Print current directory\n\tui.printItemPath(dir)\n\n\t// If we haven't reached the max depth, print contents\n\tif currentDepth &lt; ui.depth &amp;&amp; dir.IsDir() {\n\t\tfiles := dir.GetFiles()\n\n\t\t// Sort files\n\t\tif ui.reverseSort {\n\t\t\tsort.Sort(files)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tsort.Sort(sort.Reverse(files))\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Print all files at this depth level\n\t\tfor _, file := range files {\n\t\t\tif file.IsDir() {\n\t\t\t\t// Recurse into subdirectories\n\t\t\t\tui.printDirWithDepth(file, currentDepth+1)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t// Print regular files\n\t\t\t\tui.printItemPath(file)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// ReadAnalysis reads analysis report from JSON file\nfunc (ui *UI) ReadAnalysis(input io.Reader) error {\n\tvar (\n\t\tdir      *analyze.Dir\n\t\twait     sync.WaitGroup\n\t\terr      error",

        "contents": "&#96;\n\n// nolint: funlen // Why: complex function\nfunc (ui *UI) showDir() {\n\tvar (\n\t\ttotalUsage int64\n\t\ttotalSize  int64\n\t\tmaxUsage   int64\n\t\tmaxSize    int64\n\t\titemCount  int\n\t)\n\n\tui.currentDirPath = ui.currentDir.GetPath()\n\n\tif ui.changeCwdFn != nil {\n\t\terr := ui.changeCwdFn(ui.currentDirPath)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"error setting cwd: %s\", err.Error())\n\t\t}\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"changing cwd to %s\", ui.currentDirPath)\n\t}\n\n\tui.currentDirLabel.SetText(\"[::b] --- \" +\n\t\ttview.Escape(\n\t\t\tstrings.TrimPrefix(ui.currentDirPath, build.RootPathPrefix),\n\t\t) +\n\t\t\" ---\").SetDynamicColors(true)\n\n\tui.table.Clear()\n\n\trowIndex := 0\n\tif ui.currentDirPath != ui.topDirPath {\n\t\tprefix := \"                         \"\n\t\tif len(ui.markedRows) &gt; 0 {\n\t\t\tprefix += \"  \"\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcell := tview.NewTableCell(prefix + \"[::b]/..\")\n\n\t\t// Use the collapsed parent logic to handle navigation back through collapsed paths\n\t\tvar collapsedParent fs.Item\n\t\tif ui.collapsePath {\n\t\t\tcollapsedParent = findCollapsedParent(ui.currentDir)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tcollapsedParent = ui.currentDir.GetParent()\n\t\t}\n\t\tcell.SetReference(collapsedParent)\n\t\tcell.SetStyle(tcell.Style{}.Foreground(tcell.ColorDefault))\n\t\tui.table.SetCell(0, 0, cell)\n\t\trowIndex++\n\t}\n\n\tui.sortItems()\n\n\tunlock := ui.currentDir.RLock()\n\tdefer unlock()\n\n\ti := rowIndex\n\tmaxUsage = 0\n\tmaxSize = 0\n\tfor _, item := range ui.currentDir.GetFiles() {\n\t\tif _, ignored := ui.ignoredRows[i]; ignored {\n\t\t\ti++\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ui.ShowRelativeSize {\n\t\t\tif item.GetUsage() &gt; maxUsage {\n\t\t\t\tmaxUsage = item.GetUsage()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif item.GetSize() &gt; maxSize {\n\t\t\t\tmaxSize = item.GetSize()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tmaxSize += item.GetSize()\n\t\t\tmaxUsage += item.GetUsage()\n\t\t}\n\t\ti++\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, item := range ui.currentDir.GetFiles()",

On Linux, Stat_t doesn't have Birthtime in the standard syscall package. We need golang.org/x/sys/unix for Stat_t with Birthtime (Linux 4.11+ has statx with STATX_BTIME). So creation time support will be:
- Darwin/BSD: syscall.Stat_t has Birthtimespec
- Linux: use unix.Statx or keep Ctime zero / use Mtime fallback
- Windows: Win32FileAttributeData has CreationTime

I'll note in the plan that creation time is platform-dependent and may be zero on some systems.

Creating the plan now.

Options:

2. Use protobuf for compact binary representation
3. Keep the hierarchical JSON but make gds traverse it

The user also wants:
- Index while scanning (stream to file)
- Auto-cache results based on params

I think the best approach is:
1. Create a **flat NDJSON format** (one JSON object per file per line) - this is still "JSON like gdu" but flat for easy streaming and searching
2. Or use **protobuf** for smaller size and faster parsing
3. Add a **cache manager** that hashes the scan parameters (path, ignore patterns, flags) and stores/retrieves cached index files

1. **Use NDJSON format** (newline-delimited JSON, one file per line) - compatible with gdu's JSON ecosystem while being flat and streamable
2. **Stream during scan** - write records immediately as files are discovered, not after building a tree
3. **Auto-caching** - hash scan parameters (path, ignore rules, filters) and store/retrieve cached indexes from `~/.cache/gdu/indexes/`
4. **Protocol Buffers as optional upgrade** for better performance if needed

The architecture now includes a cache manager that checks if an index exists for the given parameters and auto-loads it on subsequent runs.

Everything is done. Here's a summary of what was built and the design changes:

### What changed

**Cache system** -- Replaced the complex SHA256-hashed cache in `~/.cache/gdu/indexes/` with a simple file:
- Cache file: `.gdu-cache-<foldername>.ndjson` placed **inside the scanned directory**
- E.g., `gdu index /home/user/projects` creates `/home/user/projects/.gdu-cache-projects.ndjson`

**`gdu index`** -- No `--output`, `--use-cache`, or `--cache-dir` flags. It just works:
- `gdu index` -- indexes current directory, saves to `.gdu-cache-<dir>.ndjson`
- `gdu index /some/path` -- indexes that path, saves cache there
- `gdu index --force-refresh` -- rescans even if cache exists
- On re-run with same path, prints "Index already exists" and skips

**`gds`** -- No file argument at all. Auto-discovers the index:
- `gds "*.go"` -- finds nearest `.gdu-cache-*.ndjson` by walking up from cwd
- `gds --ext .rs` -- filter by extension
- `gds -d /home/user "config"` -- override search start directory
- `gds --format table` -- show all files in a table with size + mtime
- Supports `--min-size`, `--max-size`, `--since`, `--until`, `--case-sensitive`

**Index format** -- NDJSON (one JSON object per line), matching gdu's JSON style:
```json
{"name":"file.go","path":"/full/path/file.go","size":2048,"mtime":1704067200,"ctime":1704067100,"ext":".go"}
```
